title: SynerGPCR: source code for the GPCR assay-chain database and analyses
description:
Source code for building SynerGPCR, a GPCR assay-chain database linking functional assay-chain completeness to clinical translatability (https://synergpcr.kaist.ac.kr), and for regenerating the reported analyses from the archived data tables (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21943761).

Licences: code MIT; data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA and the Zenodo data record).
